affinity_policy: no affinity change; scheduler under inherited mask; no taskset
block_inode_accounting: 32MiB payload +2MiB logs/terminal +16MiB optional input copy +1MiB block/directory/lock overhead +77MiB reserve =128MiB fresh capacity
temporary_strategy: stream JSON directly to exclusive output; retain partial on STOP; no temp/final duplicate; no /tmp
quota_policy: current mount rw,relatime: quota not advertised; if enabled later, STOP pending read-only quota headroom receipt
observation: host plus own visible cgroup ancestors read-only; no worker/observer process
pressure_gate: host full avg10 <1%; all visible own cgroup full avg10=0
oom_gate: host and own visible ancestor OOM counters unchanged from baseline; historical nonzero baseline not fabricated as new OOM
cleanup: one foreground analysis process; no children; normal file contexts; retain one-shot marker/output on completion or failure
